Copilot Instructions for lbstfun

What This Package Does

lbstfun is an R utility package for L-BioStat statistical reporting. It wraps the gt package to provide helper functions for formatting p-values and applying bold styling to table headers and significant results.

The package also ships two statistical analysis vignettes (cLDA and ITS) and an example dataset (priority) from a longitudinal trial.

Build, Test, and Document Commands

All commands run from an R console with the working directory set to the package root:

# Load package for interactive development
devtools::load_all()

# Regenerate documentation from roxygen2 comments (updates man/ and NAMESPACE)
devtools::document()

# Run full test suite
devtools::test()

# Run a single test file
testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-fmt_pvalue.R")

# Full R CMD CHECK (run before any release)
devtools::check()

# Build pkgdown documentation site
pkgdown::build_site()

Architecture

Three exported functions, each in its own file under R/:

File Function Purpose
R/fmt_pvalue.R fmt_pvalue() Format p-value columns in a gt table via scales::label_pvalue()
R/tab_bold_headers.R tab_bold_headers() Bold column headers (and optionally spanner headers)
R/tab_bold_pvalues.R tab_bold_pvalues() Bold rows where a p-value column falls at or below a threshold

All functions follow the same pattern: accept a gt_tbl object as the first argument and return a modified gt_tbl, making them pipe-friendly.

Example dataset priority (longitudinal trial data) lives in data/ and is generated by data-raw/priority.R from a SAS source file.

Key Conventions

One file per exported function

Each exported function has exactly one corresponding R/<function>.R file and one tests/testthat/test-<function>.R file.

Documentation is roxygen2

All function docs use #' roxygen2 comments. Use @inheritParams when a function shares parameters with another (e.g., inheriting data, columns, rows from fmt_pvalue). Run devtools::document() after any documentation change — never edit man/ files directly.

Tidy evaluation with {{}}

Functions that accept unquoted column names use the {{}} (embrace) operator from rlang. The column argument in tab_bold_pvalues() is the canonical example.

Native pipe

Use the native R pipe |> (R 4.1+), not %>%.

Snake_case everywhere

Function names and arguments use snake_case (e.g., tab_bold_headers, add_p, accuracy).

Test structure

Tests extract the internal tbl$_styles list from a rendered gt table to verify that styling was applied to the correct rows/columns. Follow this pattern when adding tests for new styling functions.

Dependencies

Only add to Imports in DESCRIPTION if a package is used in exported functions. Packages used only in vignettes or tests belong in Suggests.
